Testing Guide

Test Markers

All tests are marked with the following Pytest markers:

  • @pytest.mark.web — page load / HTML structure.

  • @pytest.mark.buttons — button endpoints & busy-state behavior.

  • @pytest.mark.analysis — labels and percentage formatting.

  • @pytest.mark.db — database schema/inserts/selects.

  • @pytest.mark.integration — end-to-end flows.

Several fixtures are included as well; they are distinguished in the Reference below by not being preceeded by test_.

Running Tests

The automated test suite is run with pytest; running the command below from the project root will test the entire stack:

pytest -m "web or buttons or analysis or db or integration"

To run the tests with coverage:

pytest -m "web or buttons or analysis or db or integration" --cov=src
